items.title: Sporty Styles HD
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Throw on your favorite jersey, because it's time to root for the home team with this skin pack of sports fashion. Whether you're cheering on the sidelines or on the field playing for a crowd, there's an outfit for every occasion!

- Includes a whopping 15 HD skins!
- Each skin is detailed with various colors
- By PixelPoly Digital & Pathway Studios

items.title: Autumn Vibes
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Step out into the brisk, cool air in styles that remind you of pumpkin spice and campfires with this skin pack of fall-inspired outfits. With cardigans, overalls, and the most comfortable sweaters, you'll be cozying up by the fire in no time.

- Includes 10 unique and stylish skins
- Male and female options with a variety of outfits
- By Lux Studios & Pathway Studios

items.title: The King's Crown
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Your kingdom is under attack! As king, you must protect your people and your crown. Find the ten keys needed to ring the alarm and alert your citizens of the approaching attackers.

- Explore your kingdom to find the 10 keys.
- Fight through hordes of monsters in the deepest, darkest parts of your castle.
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios.

items.title: Foodimals: Remashed
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description: Enjoyed the first course? It's time for a second helping of Foodimals! A perfect set for starting a restaurant, getting take-out, and even more.

items.title: Starlight Fairytale
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Starlight Kingdom has seen peace for hundreds of years. Suddenly, an evil presence emerges from the shadows. The witch has cast a spell over the once peaceful lands, turning even the friendliest creatures into dangerous foes. You and your friends must work together to undo the damage once more.

+ 1.16 fantasy texture pack
+ 8 skins
+ Fantasy storyline
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Cool Aesthetic
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Cool vibes all the way! Try out a new aesthetic while exploring new fashion styles. Be as free as a bird and find your free spirit in a variety of clothes! Find what suits you the best and become the best version of yourself. Get ready, because you are going to blow minds with these stunning styles!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 cool teen skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Realistic Furniture
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Decorate your modern world with REALISTIC FURNITURE! WATCH TRAILER FOR MORE INFO.

+ 650 furniture options!
+ Interactive items!
+ 3D decorating tools to play with!
+ Modern city included!

items.title: Golems+
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Master golem crafting and create powerful golems from almost any material! The village has grown and needs new protectors. Build an ice golem that freezes water, or one out of slime that jumps and divides.

27 new iron variants
16 new snow variants
2 new wither variants
8 languages supported
Battle arena
Multiplayer fun

How many zombies could a diamond version defeat?
items.changelog:
- 5 new golem types!
- Tame the Camel Golem with wheat and ride it!
- More mobs to choose from in the arena.
- New crafting recipes.
- New areas to explore.
- Update 1.20 blocks and items supported.

items.title: Dark Anime Teens 2
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Look cute in modern outfits with this second installment of dark anime teens! Includes trendy accessories like crowns, demon horns and more! Choose your favorite among these 10 different skins.

- 10 skins in dark clothing
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: One Block Challenge
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
One Block Challenge is a sky block map!

Break one block to get more!

+ 2 one block maps
items.changelog:
+ Обновено до 1.19.20
+ Призовете пазача!
+ Порталът към Края в оригиналната карта е преместен малко по-далеч от първоначалното място за появяване

items.title: Lucky Block Winter Island
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Enjoy the lucky block experience with great rewards and risks on a cold winter island!

+75 lucky block events
+ 1 aquarium
+ Many rooms with tiny animals!
+ Single and multiplayer friendly!
+ By Block Tale Studios!

items.title: Cherry Blossoms
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Find your pink bliss with the cherry blossoms. These peaceful skins are perfect for relaxing on a summer day or taking a stroll through a park. With bright colors and unique inspiration these trendy skins are beautiful!

- 13 skins

items.title: Free Anime Buddies
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Free Anime Buddies will make your dreams of being a character come true! In this pack, you will find 20 awesome skins ranging from demons, students, and many other characters! Become the coolest teen in your friend group and have fun!

- Includes 20 anime skins
- 2 free skins!
- Great for roleplay!
- By CribSon

items.title: Collab Pack 3
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
This is collection we all been waiting for!
Grab a onesie or a something else! 
We have a special look for everybody!


+ 1 free girl.
+ 1 free boy.
+ 10 epic skins!

items.title: Collab Pack 2
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Be ready for another collaboration pack! 
Suit up and go out to go skyblock, adventure or just explore?
Take out your favorite skin and add it to your collection!

+ 1 free girl.
+ 1 free boy.
+ 10 epic skins!

items.title: Police and Robbers
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Do you feel like playing cops and robbers? The crooks stole all the money from the bank! It's up to you to catch them and return the money! Are you the best police officer in existence? Yes? Good! The world needs you to free it from all it's crooks!

+5 police skins!
+5 robber skins!
+Amazing for roleplay!
+Amazing for YouTube videos!

items.title: Original Dropper
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Are you the ultimate dropper master? Then try this original dropper! With 15 levels from easy to difficult, you will not be finished quickly! Each dropper has its own theme such as medieval castles, skyblock, space, donuts, lucky block and more! Can you survive the fall?

+15 levels!
+Death counter!
+15 original droppers!

items.title: Anime Demon Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Anime Demon Teens! Wear some horns and cause some mischief. These skins are equally cool, cute, and devilish! 

- 12 skins
- Fun and colorful skin designs

items.title: Earth Armor
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Be as strong as the Earth! This armor is great for roleplay and just looking cool and strong. With colors inspired by the Earth, you'll find your new favorite skin here!

- 12 awesome armored skins
- Modern and cool designs
- Perfect for teens and roleplay

items.title: Slumber Party
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
Sssssh, it's time for bed! Are you ready to get cosy in your pyjamas or maybe a dinosaur onesie? Whatever you are wearing you will look great at this slumber party! 

+ 12 cute modern skins
+ Perfect for teens to roleplay a sleepover

items.title: Valhalla Vikings
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Adventure awaits in Valhalla! 10 of the most worthy Viking warriors and Nordic pets have been chosen, and are ready to sail, explore, fight and survive. Armor up with this skin pack and stand out from the masses as a hero!

items.title: City Demons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Demons are everywhere! Put on your horns in the city and cause a little mischief. It's fun and cool to be a little devilish sometimes. Play with your friends and have a good time.

- 12 skins
- Colorful options
- Modern skin designs

items.title: Floral Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Pick up some perfect spring and summer-themed floral skins in this pack! Decorated with colorful flowers and skin designs intended for teens, you'll look great in any of these modern styles!

- 12 skins
- Cute designs

items.title: One Block
items.creator: Diveblocks
items.description:
Have you ever experienced a One Block experience in Minecraft? Join our challenge in this extreme single block adventure.

- Minigames
- Challenges
- Customized crafts and trades 
- Dungeons
- By Dalibu Studios
